NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

today announced the launch of the Cosmos Partner Network, bringing together leading industry service providers to help global financial players accelerate digital asset initiatives through the Cosmos Tokenization Suite and Cosmos digital ledger solutions. These partners bring the deep industry expertise, global delivery capacity, and proven results banks and financial institutions need to move their business forward in a digital-first market.

The Cosmos Tokenization Suite enables banks and credit unions to benefit from capabilities like 24/7 payment settlement and improved treasury management. It also unlocks first-to-market use cases such as programmable escrow, programmable trade finance, and agentic commerce. At the same time, vendor coordination remains a key barrier to accessing these benefits.

Cosmos and the Cosmos Partner Network provide a turnkey infrastructure to safely and seamlessly offer tokenized deposits to power these new digital use cases. Cosmos provides the tokenization and ledger platform, while Partner Network members deliver integrated services and products, such as KYC/KYB verification, custody, and regulatory compliance monitoring. This combined effort eliminates the friction of building multi-vendor solutions from scratch.

"Financial institutions understand the potential of tokenization, but it's difficult to move from a pilot to a high-quality, live customer experience," said Maghnus Mareneck, Co-CEO of Cosmos. "The Cosmos Partner Network brings together the specialized firms that institutions need to modernize their business through tokenization and digital assets, while reducing the complexity of sourcing those providers individually."
The Cosmos Partner Network launches with seventeen initial participants that offer a complete service suite for tokenized finance:

, an institutional-grade on-chain infrastructure layer for the digital asset economy.

, a regulated provider of institutional digital asset infrastructure for the custody, settlement, trading, escrow, and collateral management of digital assets.
BCW Group
, a SOC-II certified enterprise solutions firm and venture studio dedicated to building AI, blockchain, and cloud infrastructure.

, a regulated digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services.
Blockchain.com
, a leading global digital asset platform offering 24/7 institutional OTC trading, tailored market making, and enterprise-grade custody solutions.
Blockdaemon

, an institutional gateway to Web3 for exchanges, custodians, crypto platforms, and financial enterprises, offering blockchain infrastructure spanning nodes, APIs, staking, MPC wallets, and vaults since 2017.
Coinbax
, a compliance and controls layer for stablecoin payments, providing banks and fintechs with transaction-level screening, built-in payment reversibility, and programmable escrow.

, a core banking platform for digital assets and the leading wallet infrastructure for on-chain finance, giving banks, fintechs, and enterprises the infrastructure to issue, move, and govern money & assets on-chain.
Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY)

, a digital asset financial services and infrastructure company serving institutions across trading, financing, asset management, staking, and tokenization, with self-custody and key management built for banks and regulated institutions.

, a proactive on-chain security platform that predicts and neutralizes digital asset threats before they materialize, unifying real-time monitoring, transaction security, fraud prevention, compliance screening, and automated response.
InfStones
, a blockchain-agnostic infrastructure company delivering secure Web3 solutions across the stack, from developer infrastructure and DePIN to liquidity and yield-generating products.
OpenZeppelin

, a blockchain security firm whose smart contract standards sit behind stablecoins and tokenized funds, that provides architecture, build, and continuous security coverage for financial institutions, networks, and protocols.
Peersyst Technology

Silence Laboratories
, a provider of bank-grade, on-prem custody infrastructure, offering multi-HSM custody and production-ready PQ (quantum secure) wallets.
Ubyx

, an acceptance network for tokenized money designed to achieve stablecoin and tokenized-deposit ubiquity, connecting issuers with banks and fintechs and enabling seamless conversion to fiat cash equivalents.
Utila

, a digital asset infrastructure platform for fintechs and enterprises, combining institutional-grade MPC wallets, granular policy controls, and deep integrations across banking, compliance, and exchanges.
Zeeve
, an enterprise blockchain infrastructure and systems integration platform helping banks and enterprises build, deploy, and operate production-grade blockchain and digital asset solutions.

The program recognizes partners for the value they create and allows them to scale their business through introductions across the public and private networks that use Cosmos. The ecosystem of trusted partners can also participate in tokenized deposit initiatives and use cases with the financial institutions and banks Cosmos is actively working with. This enables these banks to leverage leading blockchain companies to support their tokenized deposit and digital ledger initiatives. Furthermore, companies of every size building on Cosmos gain access to a curated group of best-in-class experts who understand Cosmos, should they wish to engage their services.

children: About Cosmos

Cosmos is the world's leading neutral, open-source digital ledger stack and DLT solutions provider, powering 150+ blockchains across finance, payments, and global business. Established in 2016, Cosmos gives institutions and governments technology and solutions for interoperable digital asset capabilities, with $70bn+ in assets secured and 10 years of production resilience. Cosmos Labs leads development and growth for Cosmos as a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Interchain Foundation, the non-profit that supports Cosmos and its decentralized technologies. To learn more about Cosmos, follow
Cosmos on LinkedIn, or visit cosmos.network.
